verdict.rationale: Runway Dev is a documented public HTTP API. It has concrete endpoints (`POST /v1/text_to_video`, `GET /v1/tasks/{id}` polling), an npm SDK, cURL examples and a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec, and probes confirmed both the spec and llms.txt return HTTP 200. The community items concern the 2021 web editor and say nothing about the API, so they were ignored. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on reports of driving the API end to end.
